# GOG — production assignments and unchanged training stats

- Original source: [How is crafting supposed to work?](https://www.gog.com/forum/robin_hood_legend_of_sherwood/how_is_crafting_supposed_to_work/page1)
- Author / publication: polysquirrel and radkyeah; GOG forum.
- Language / date: English; 2020-09-16 and 2020-11-30.
- Access: Both posts inspected through indexed text; direct retrieval failed.
- Checked: 2026-09-09
- Format: original summary and research notes; not a transcript.

polysquirrel reports assigning camp tasks, seeing the corresponding icons, and completing forest missions without receiving supplies. The post also distinguishes a training entry on the summary parchment from unchanged character statistics.

radkyeah replies that generic forest missions rarely, if ever, produce supplies, whereas story missions do. The reply addresses production but does not resolve the reported training discrepancy. This is an earlier, more detailed account than the [2023 parchment discussion](gog-production-parchment.md), with no follow-up confirming the explanation or a controlled comparison of mission types.
